findings.description: The new containment helper is applied only to the enumeration root. Get-ReviewAuthorityCampaignRunResults validates the campaigns/<id>/runs directory, then enumerates child directories and directly joins and reads result.json without sending each child path back through Get-ReviewAuthorityStorePath. A reparse-point child beneath a clean runs directory is therefore followed; the same gap exists for recursively enumerated grant/reservation/spend/release facts at line 200. A checkout-borne link with a valid child name and a schema-valid fact can make out-of-store data enter signoff or allowance decisions, contradicting T082's claim that every read and enumeration is contained. Reject link entries during traversal or re-resolve and validate every enumerated child before reading it.
findings.title: Enumerated link children bypass authority-store containment

findings.description: state.md still says no task has completed, leaves Tasks Remaining as '(populate from plan.md)', and says execution has not started, while plan.md marks T081, T082, and T084 done and T085 in progress; T080 also remains planned although its fixtures and delivery evidence are committed. resume-iteration.ps1 parses the placeholder as a literal task ID and reports an unknown-task blocker, so a resumed session cannot recover the actual T085 review state. Update the canonical state metadata and task statuses to the committed execution state before treating the iteration as review-ready.
findings.title: Iteration 010's resume state was never advanced

summary: Risk-based review completed. Both controller-declared verification commands succeeded against the exact target digest, but the authority-store containment correction still permits enumeration-derived links to supply out-of-store authority facts. Iteration 010's checked-in task/resume state is also stale and blocks the supported resume path.
